notes: Nothing in any of the seven corpora mentions SAM, MobileSAM or prompt-based segmentation - zero hits for the model itself. The two new corpora clearly win here: CalibForge supplies the only true segmentation-with-IoU task (model-training_20260603_181444_001), the only realistic checkpoint-loading traps, and the best-matching argparse+geometry+CSV form, taking 4 of the final 10; Terminal-Lego contributes real CV/geometry problems (IoU localisation, polygon offsetting, rectangle overlap) that the v1 pool lacked, though nearly all are weak-graded so only one made the final. Recursive-Task-Synthesis and TerminalWorld have no defensible 10: RTS's best is a torch-model-from-config chore and the rest are /app CSV boilerplate (all `absent`), TerminalWorld's only pretrained-detector task is FREE. SWE-Smith transfers narrowly but genuinely through fvcore, which is Meta's own detection-utility library (coordinate transforms, box IoU loss, Checkpointer).
